opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Additional support for postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, enhancing their commitment to physiology and benefiting the wider community of physiologists.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.summary: Support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.summary: Support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or to finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Support for Members to run activities that address Equity, Diversity and Inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research.
